# Rafiq v0.5.5: Notes, in Arabic and English together

Most Markdown editors scramble a line that mixes Arabic and English: "C++" turns into
"++C", "8 MB" into "MB 8", and a sentence that starts with an English word reads backwards.
Rafiq now has notes of its own that get it right
([#1](https://github.com/AhmadALSaffan/RAFIQ/issues/1)).

---

## 📝 Notes

- **A Notes page** in the sidebar. Every note is a Markdown file in a folder of your own
  (`Documents\Rafiq\notes` by default, or any folder you pick, OneDrive included), so it
  opens anywhere and stays yours.
- **Every line takes its direction from its words**, not from its first letter, and every
  English phrase inside an Arabic sentence (or Arabic inside English) stays in one piece,
  with its numbers, symbols and brackets on the right side. The same rules apply while you
  write and when you read.
- **Write or read** (Ctrl+E). It saves as you type, and if the file changed outside Rafiq it
  asks which version to keep.
- **A formatting bar** for headings, lists, tasks, tables, code, links and pictures. Paste or
  drop a picture and it's saved next to the note.
- **An outline** of the headings, **`[[links]]` between notes**, and tasks you tick while reading.
- **Folders, search and pins.** Drag a note onto a folder to move it. Search finds Arabic
  however it's spelled («اسامه» finds «أسامة»).
- **Export** to Word or PDF.

## ✨ "Help me"

- Select text and have it **tidied, continued, translated, shortened or corrected**, then
  choose whether to replace it or add the result after it.
- **Pick the model** that helps, right in the menu. Rafiq remembers it, and the result says
  which model wrote it.

## 💬 Notes in your chats

- **"Save as note"** on any reply.
- **@ has a "My notes" tab**, in chats with or without a folder. The model reads the note
  you mention.
- **The model can keep notes for you.** It writes a new note when you ask, and before it
  changes one you already have, it shows you the difference and waits for you.

## 🪟 Markdown files from Windows

- **"Open with → Rafiq"** for `.md` files. Rafiq doesn't make itself the default program.
- **Rafiq Lite:** one file in a light window of its own, just the editor. It's in the
  right-click menu of every Markdown file. When you open a file with Rafiq, it asks whether
  you want the light window or the full app, and can remember your answer (Settings →
  General).

## 🎬 What's new, after each update

- The first launch after an update shows a short video of what changed, in your language,
  with the main points under it. It stays until you close it, and the About page opens it again.

---

The notes editor is built on [CodeMirror](https://codemirror.net) (MIT). See
`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.

**Updating:** installed copies offer this update on their own. For a new install, download
`Rafiq_0.5.5_x64-setup.exe` below and check it against `SHA256SUMS.txt`:

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\Rafiq_0.5.5_x64-setup.exe -Algorithm SHA256
```
